content.text: IBM said in its 10-K filed 2024-02-26 that

citations.cited_text: To bolster our AI strategy, we established the $500 million Enterprise AI Venture Fund to deepen collaboration with early-stage innovators.

content.text: "To bolster our AI strategy, we established the $500 million Enterprise AI Venture Fund to deepen collaboration with early-stage innovators."
The promise carries no deadline. No later filing mentions the Enterprise AI Venture Fund or reports its size, and no measurable progress on it is reported, so the status is No evidence yet.
IBM said in its 10-Q filed 2025-04-24 that

citations.cited_text: In April, we announced the upcoming launch of the IBM z17, which delivers enhanced AI acceleration through multi-model AI capabilities.

content.text: In April, we announced the upcoming launch of the IBM z17, which delivers enhanced AI acceleration through multi-model AI capabilities.

citations.cited_text: In June, we launched the IBM z17, which delivers enhanced AI acceleration through multi-model AI capabilities.

content.text: In June, we launched the IBM z17, which delivers enhanced AI acceleration through multi-model AI capabilities.
The later 10-Q filed 2025-10-23 and the 10-K filed 2026-02-24 repeat the June launch, with the 10-K stating

citations.cited_text: In June 2025, we launched the IBM z17, which delivers enhanced AI acceleration through multi-model AI capabilities.

content.text: In June 2025, we launched the IBM z17, which delivers enhanced AI acceleration through multi-model AI capabilities.
The status is Delivered because the launch was reported for June 2025, within the period the promise covered.
